name: Burgess Owens

accounts.evidence: The 'Burgess Owens for Congress' campaign site (footer 'Paid for by Burgess 4 Utah') links twitter.com/BurgessOwens in its 'Follow Us On Social' section and footer.

notes: The account is likely his long-standing personal account used for campaigning; labeled campaign because the campaign site links it.

name: Jennifer A. Kiggans
notes: Campaign site jenforcongress.com was identified by search but returned HTTP 403 Forbidden on every fetch (about page, root, www root), so no X link could be confirmed.

accounts.evidence: Scott's campaign site bobbyscottforcongress.com links twitter.com/BobbyScott4VA3 in its header and footer.
McClellan's campaign site jennifermcclellan.com (listed on her 2024 FEC filing) links twitter.com/JennMcClellanVA in its social list and footer.
The 'John McGuire for Congress' campaign site mcguireva.com, which asks visitors to re-elect him in Virginia's 5th District, links twitter.com/JohnMcGuire4VA.
Cline's campaign site bencline.com links twitter.com/cline4virginia in its footer.

name: Eugene Simon Vindman

accounts.evidence: Vindman's campaign site vindmanforcongress.com has an X link (/twitter) that redirects to x.com/yvindman and embeds posts from twitter.com/yvindman.

notes: Handle confirmed via the campaign site's /twitter redirect (301 to https://x.com/yvindman); x.com itself was not opened. 'Y' presumably stands for Yevgeny; not to be confused with his twin brother Alexander Vindman. Labeled personal because the handle is name-based rather than campaign-branded; it may be used as his campaign account.

name: Donald S. Beyer, Jr.

notes: Search did not surface a campaign site; friendsofdonbeyer.com was taken from the campaign website field of his Wikipedia infobox and then opened directly.
